verdict.rationale: Agora's introduction docs name a CLI as part of its tooling for coding agents and AI workflows, which is a first-party claim. That single line is the only evidence: nothing describes the CLI's commands, installation or behavior. missing for 10: CLI documentation (install, commands, auth), evidence of what agent workflows the CLI supports, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Let your coding agent build with Agora. Connect the CLI, MCP server, and Skills to your AI workflow.
